verdict.rationale: Meilisearch ships a 'conversational search' product that lets end users ask questions and get answers grounded in indexed data, plus a RAG-focused retrieval product and personalization that adapts results to user behavior — these are AI-generated, data-grounded outputs. However, these are building-block APIs for developers to embed in their own apps rather than an in-product AI insights/suggestions experience for the Meilisearch user themselves, and there is no evidence of a dashboard or admin-facing AI-generated insights feature. Missing for 10: an in-product AI insight/analytics dashboard for the Meilisearch operator, independent evidence of conversational search quality/accuracy, and clarity that this is end-user-facing rather than developer-embedded.
